CustomField.description: Reference to an Account whose Id (customerId) and AccountNumber, or Name when AccountNumber is blank (customerCode), are used as the customer identity sent to tax engines for this Quote. Tax-calculation only — does not affect invoice ownership, billing address, or any other billing logic. Copied to Order on activation if Order has no TaxationAccount of its own.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When set, the referenced Account's Id (customerId) and AccountNumber, or Name when AccountNumber is blank (customerCode), are used as the customer identity sent to tax engines for this Quote. Propagates to the Order on activation if the Order has no override of its own.
CustomField.label: Taxation Account
